questions.stem: An isosceles triangle has two equal sides of $10\text{ cm}$ and a base of $12\text{ cm}$. What is the perpendicular height from the base to the apex?
questions.explanation: The perpendicular bisects the base, creating a right triangle with hypotenuse $10$ and base $6$. Height $= \sqrt{10^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{100 - 36} = \sqrt{64} = 8\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: A ship sails $8\text{ km}$ east and then $15\text{ km}$ north. How far is the ship from its starting point?
questions.explanation: The path forms a right angle. Distance $= \sqrt{8^2 + 15^2} = \sqrt{64 + 225} = \sqrt{289} = 17\text{ km}$.

questions.stem: The diagonal of a square is $10\text{ cm}$. What is the side length of the square?
questions.explanation: If the side is $s$, then $s^2 + s^2 = 10^2$, so $2s^2 = 100$, $s^2 = 50$, $s = \sqrt{50} = 5\sqrt{2} = \frac{10}{\sqrt{2}}\text{ cm}$. Both forms are equivalent.
